about: Party-label corrections keyed by Ethics filer number: the one list both this dashboard and Louisiana Airwaves (doombot50/Lousiana-DMAs) apply. Party is normally matched from the filer's name (la_politicians_lookup.json), which can mislabel a namesake or leave a publicly aligned committee as OTH. when=always replaces whatever the name lookup says; when=oth applies only where it says OTH. Each entry is an editorial call with its reason, so it can be audited or reverted. Edit here only: the nightly refresh publishes this file on the data-cache release and Airwaves syncs its copy from there.

1314.name: Blair Edwards
1314.why: Blair Downing Edwards, First Circuit Court of Appeal judge, ran as a Republican for the open 1st District Supreme Court seat in the May 2026 closed GOP primary (WAFB, WBRZ, Louisiana Illuminator). The name lookup matched a different Blair Edwards, a Democratic local official.
